title: sarcochilus pallidus
intro: Sarcochilus pallidus, commonly known as the Ghost Orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid found in Australia and Southeast Asia. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Sarcochilus pallidus include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections.
